<style>

*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg) radial-gradient(var(--dot) 1.5px,transparent 1.5px) 0 0/16px 16px;color:var(--ink);font:17px/1.65 -apple-system,"Noto Sans TC","PingFang TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:var(--pri);color:#fff;border-bottom:3px solid var(--sh);padding:8px 12px 6px;padding-top:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));margin-top:calc(-1 * env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}
.hr{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px}
h1{font-size:17px;margin:0;line-height:1.3}
.sc{font-weight:700;color:var(--hi);white-space:nowrap}
.rs{background:#fff;color:#10302c;border:2px solid #10302c;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:2px 2px 0 #10302c;padding:2px 10px;font-size:13px;margin-left:8px}
nav{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:6px 0 2px;scrollbar-width:none}
nav a{flex:0 0 auto;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:999px;padding:0 10px}
nav a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
main{max-width:900px;margin:auto;padding:8px 10px 90px}
.guide{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--sh);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;margin:12px 0;font-size:15px}
.guide .k{display:inline-block;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:6px;padding:0 8px;background:var(--okb);font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
a.w{color:var(--link);font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline dotted;text-decoration-thickness:2px;text-underline-offset:3px;cursor:pointer}
a.w:hover{background:var(--hi);color:#10302c;border-radius:3px}
h2{display:inline-block;background:var(--hi);color:#10302c;border:3px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--sh);border-radius:8px;padding:2px 14px;margin:30px 0 2px;font-size:19px;transform:rotate(-1deg);scroll-margin-top:96px}
.goal{font-size:14px;color:var(--mu);margin:8px 2px 4px}
.ps{background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--sh);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin:14px 0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.9}
.ps .ph{display:inline-block;background:var(--pri);color:#fff;font-weight:700;border-radius:6px;padding:0 10px;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:6px}

.ps p.ni{text-indent:0}
u.bl{text-decoration:none;background:var(--hi);color:#10302c;font-weight:700;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:6px;padding:0 8px;margin:0 2px;font-size:15px;white-space:nowrap}
.bank{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 8px;margin-top:8px;padding-top:8px;border-top:2px dashed var(--ink);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;text-indent:0}
.bank.col{display:block}
.bank .bi{border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:8px;padding:0 8px;background:var(--soft)}
.bank.col .bi{display:block;margin:6px 0;padding:2px 10px}
.bank b{color:var(--pri)}
.duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin:14px 0}
@media(max-width:720px){.duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.duo .ps{margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.8}
.q{background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--sh);border-top:10px solid var(--pri);border-radius:14px;padding:12px;margin:16px 0;scroll-margin-top:96px}
.qh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.n{background:var(--pri);color:#fff;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:50%;min-width:34px;height:34px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;transform:rotate(-6deg);padding:0 6px}
.lv{font-size:13px;background:var(--soft);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:6px;padding:0 8px}
.stem{margin:2px 0 8px}
.rw{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:stretch;margin:7px 0}
.o{flex:0 0 66px;background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--sh);padding:6px 0;font-weight:700;text-align:center}
.o:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translate(-1px,-1px);background:var(--okb)}
.o.sel{background:var(--hi);color:#10302c}
.o.ok{background:var(--okb);border-color:var(--ok);color:var(--ink);animation:pop .35s}
.o.no{background:var(--nob);border-color:var(--no);color:var(--ink)}
.o:disabled{cursor:default}
@keyframes pop{50%{transform:scale(1.08)}}
.ot{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;border:2px dashed var(--ink);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 12px;background:var(--card)}
.ot img{max-width:100%;max-height:230px;display:block;margin:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:6px}
.rw.done.right .ot{background:var(--okb)}
.g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:2px 10px}
.imgq{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px 10px}
@media(max-width:620px){.imgq{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ex{margin-top:10px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--soft);border:2px dashed var(--ink);border-radius:10px;font-size:16px}

input.ib.no{background:var(--nob);border-color:var(--no)}
.b{background:var(--pri);color:#fff;border:2px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:2px 2px 0 var(--sh);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 16px;margin:6px 6px 0 0}
.b:disabled{opacity:.5}
.hint{font-size:14px;color:var(--mu);margin:4px 0}
.fz{font-size:14px;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:6px}
.fs{line-height:2.4;font-size:18px}
.nt{background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--sh);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 14px;margin:16px 0;font-size:16px}
.nt summary{font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 8px;margin:8px 0}
.chips a{border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:0 10px;background:var(--soft);font-size:15px}
.nt p{margin:8px 0}
.nt .qn{display:inline-block;background:var(--hi);color:#10302c;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:6px;padding:0 6px;font-size:13px;margin-right:4px}
#pop{display:none;position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));margin:auto;max-width:620px;background:var(--pop);color:var(--popt);border:3px solid var(--sh);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--sh);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 40px 12px 14px;z-index:30;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}
#pop .hw{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}

#pop .sp{cursor:pointer;font-size:20px;margin-left:4px;background:none;border:0;color:inherit}
#pop .x{position:absolute;right:8px;top:6px;background:none;border:0;font-size:22px;color:inherit}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--mu);font-size:13px;margin:30px 0 10px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

["Even Winnie the Pooh might be surprised at this: not all bees buzz around a <a class=\"w\" data-k=\"hive\">hive</a>, make honey, or serve a queen. In fact, the <a class=\"w\" data-k=\"hive\">hive</a>-oriented social bees are the exception in the bee world. Over 90% of the world’s bee species lead <a class=\"w\" data-k=\"solitary\">solitary</a> lives instead.", "<a class=\"w\" data-k=\"solitary\">Solitary</a> bees typically live for a year, but their active adult stage lasts only a few weeks. Most of their life is spent developing inside their nests. In spring, they emerge and mate. Shortly after mating, males die, while females begin nesting, usually in natural tunnels or artificial ones in beehouses. Inside the nest, the female constructs several separate cells divided by mud, each holding a single egg and supplied with a ball of pollen and <a class=\"w\" data-k=\"nectar\">nectar</a> as food. const L="ABCDEFGHIJ";
const m=document.getElementById("m"),pop=document.getElementById("pop"),nav=document.getElementById("nav");
let ok=0,done=0,tot=0;
DATA.forEach(d=>{if(d.k==="q"||d.k==="fill")tot++});
function upd(){document.getElementById("sc").textContent="⭐ "+ok+" / "+done+"（共 "+tot+" 題）"}
upd();
const E=(t,c,h)=>{const e=document.createElement(t);if(c)e.className=c;if(h!=null)e.innerHTML=h;return e};
function say(t){try{speechSynthesis.cancel();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(t);u.lang="en-US";u.rate=.9;speechSynthesis.speak(u)}catch(e){}}
function showWord(k){const v=V[k];if(!v)return;
 pop.innerHTML='<button class="x" aria-label="關閉">×</button><span class="hw">'+k+'</span><button class="sp" data-t="'+k.replace(/"/g,"")+'" aria-label="朗讀">🔊</button>'+(v[2]?'<span class="ip">'+v[2]+'</span>':'')+'<div>'+v[0]+'</div><div class="rt"><b>字根・構詞</b>'+v[1]+'</div>';
 pop.style.display="block"}
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{
 const sp=e.target.closest("#pop .sp");if(sp){say(sp.dataset.t);return}
 if(e.target.closest("#pop .x")){pop.style.display="none";return}
 const w=e.target.closest("a.w");
 if(w&&w.dataset.k){showWord(w.dataset.k);e.preventDefault();return}
 if(!e.target.closest("#pop"))pop.style.display="none"});
function finish(card,good,html){done++;if(good)ok++;upd();
 const e=E("div","ex",'<span class="v">'+(good?"✅ 答對了！":"❌ 再想想看。")+"</span>"+html);card.appendChild(e)}
function row(letter,txt){const r=E("div","rw");const b=E("button","o","("+letter+")");b.type="button";const t=E("div","ot",txt);r.append(b,t);return[r,b]}
const norm=s=>s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[.。!]+$/,"").replace(/\s+/g," ");
let secN=0,bank=null,bankSent=false;
DATA.forEach(d=>{
 if(d.k==="h2"){const h=E("h2",null,d.t);h.id="sec"+secN;m.appendChild(h);
  const a=E("a",null,d.t.replace(/^[^、]*、/,""));a.href="#sec"+secN;nav.appendChild(a);secN++;
  if(d.goal)m.appendChild(E("div","goal","🎯 "+d.goal))}
 else if(d.k==="p"){const c=E("div","ps");c.appendChild(E("span","ph",d.head));
  d.paras.forEach((p,i)=>c.appendChild(E("p",i?"":"ni",p)));
  bank=d.bank;bankSent=!!(d.bank&&d.bank[0].replace(/<[^>]+>/g,"").length>40);
  if(bank){const b=E("div","bank"+(bankSent?" col":""));
   bank.forEach((x,i)=>b.appendChild(E("span","bi","<b>("+L[i]+")</b> "+x)));c.appendChild(b)}
  m.appendChild(c)}
 else if(d.k==="duo"){const g=E("div","duo");[d.a,d.b].forEach(x=>{const c=E("div","ps");c.appendChild(E("span","ph",x[0]));x[1].forEach((p,i)=>c.appendChild(E("p",i?"":"ni",p)));g.appendChild(c)});m.appendChild(g)}
 else if(d.k==="note"){const n=E("details","nt");n.innerHTML="<summary>📚 重點字詞・句型（點開）</summary>";
  const ch=E("div","chips");d.chips.forEach(c=>ch.appendChild(E("a","w",c[0])).dataset.k=c[1]);
  n.appendChild(ch);d.pts.forEach(p=>n.appendChild(E("p",null,'<i class="qn">第 '+p[0]+' 題</i><b>'+p[1]+'</b>　'+p[2])));m.appendChild(n)}
 else if(d.k==="q")renderQ(d);
 else if(d.k==="fill")renderFill(d);
});
function renderQ(d){
 const c=E("div","q");c.id="q"+d.n;
 c.appendChild(E("div","qh",'<span class="n">'+d.n+'</span><span class="lv">難易度：'+d.lv+'</span>'));
 let finished=false;
 if(d.ty==="mc"){
  if(d.stem)c.appendChild(E("div","stem",d.stem));
  const w=E("div",d.opts[0].startsWith("<img")?"imgq":"");const bs=[];
  d.opts.forEach((t,i)=>{const[r,b]=row(L[i],t);bs.push([r,b]);
   b.onclick=()=>{if(finished)return;finished=true;
    bs.forEach(([r2,b2],j)=>{b2.disabled=true;r2.classList.add("done");if(j===d.a){b2.classList.add("ok");r2.classList.add("right")}});
    if(i!==d.a)b.classList.add("no");
    finish(c,i===d.a,"正確答案：<b>("+L[d.a]+")</b>。"+d.ex)};
   w.appendChild(r)});
  c.appendChild(w)}
 else if(d.ty==="bank"){
  c.appendChild(E("div","stem","請選出第 <b>"+d.n+"</b> 格應填入的"+(bankSent?"句子：":"字詞：")));
  const w=E("div",bankSent?"":"g");const bs=[];
  bank.forEach((t,i)=>{const[r,b]=row(L[i],t);bs.push([r,b]);
   b.onclick=()=>{if(finished)return;finished=true;
    bs.forEach(([r2,b2],j)=>{b2.disabled=true;r2.classList.add("done");if(j===d.a){b2.classList.add("ok");r2.classList.add("right")}});
    if(i!==d.a)b.classList.add("no");
    finish(c,i===d.a,d.ex)};
   w.appendChild(r)});
  c.appendChild(w)}
 else if(d.ty==="txt"){
  c.appendChild(E("div","stem",d.stem));if(d.hint)c.appendChild(E("div","hint","💡 "+d.hint));
  const i=E("input");i.type="text";i.placeholder="輸入答案";i.autocomplete="off";i.autocapitalize="off";i.spellcheck=false;
  const b=E("button","b","檢查");b.type="button";
  b.onclick=()=>{if(finished)return;finished=true;i.disabled=true;b.disabled=true;
   const good=d.ans.includes(norm(i.value));
   finish(c,good,"正確答案：<b>"+d.ans[0]+"</b>。<br>"+d.ex)};
  i.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter")b.click()});
  const w=E("div");w.append(i,b);c.appendChild(w)}
 else if(d.ty==="multi"){
  c.appendChild(E("div","stem",d.stem));const sel=new Set(),bs=[];
  d.opts.forEach((t,i)=>{const[r,b]=row(L[i],t);bs.push([r,b]);
   b.onclick=()=>{if(finished)return;sel.has(i)?sel.delete(i):sel.add(i);b.classList.toggle("sel",sel.has(i))};c.appendChild(r)});
  const g=E("button","b","送出答案");g.type="button";
  g.onclick=()=>{if(finished)return;finished=true;g.disabled=true;
   bs.forEach(([r,b],j)=>{b.disabled=true;b.classList.remove("sel");r.classList.add("done");
    if(d.a.includes(j)){b.classList.add("ok");r.classList.add("right")}else if(sel.has(j))b.classList.add("no")});
   const good=d.a.length===sel.size&&d.a.every(j=>sel.has(j));
   finish(c,good,d.ex)};
  c.appendChild(g)}
 m.appendChild(c)}
function renderFill(d){
 const c=E("div","q");c.id="fill"+d.n;
 c.appendChild(E("div","qh",'<span class="n">'+d.n+'</span><span class="lv">重點填空</span>'));
 c.appendChild(E("div","stem","中文：<b>"+d.zh+"</b>"));
 c.appendChild(E("div","fz","在空格填入關鍵字詞（空格內的灰字是中文提示）；同義寫法也會判對。"));
 const s=E("div","fs");const ins=[];
 d.parts.forEach(p=>{if(typeof p==="string"){s.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",p)}
  else{const i=E("input","ib");i.type="text";i.placeholder=p.h;i.autocomplete="off";i.autocapitalize="off";i.spellcheck=false;i.dataset.ok=JSON.stringify(p.ok);ins.push(i);s.appendChild(i)}});
 c.appendChild(s);
 let finished=false;
 const b=E("button","b","檢查");b.type="button";
 b.onclick=()=>{if(finished)return;finished=true;b.disabled=true;let good=true;
  ins.forEach(i=>{i.disabled=true;const okL=JSON.parse(i.dataset.ok);const hit=okL.includes(norm(i.value));
   i.classList.add(hit?"ok":"no");if(!hit){good=false;i.value=(i.value?i.value+" → ":"")+okL[0]}});
  finish(c,good,d.ex)};
 c.appendChild(b);m.appendChild(c)}
